summary: The UserPromptSubmit hook runs the scorer; attended DIRECT is an ordinary commit; the failure ledger is removed

tests.command:
bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh
bash tests/test-triage-landing.sh
bash -c 'bash tests/test-epic-goal-stop.sh && bash tests/test-native-points.sh'
bash -c '[ -f scripts/compound-v-preeval.py ] || exit 0; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/compound-v-preeval.py --selftest'
bash -c '[ -f tests/test-native-points.sh ] || exit 0; bash tests/test-native-points.sh'
bash -c 'for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
